subject: Problem with path (?) when installing RStan on Win 7

messages.author: 757a42d1a356a239
messages.subject: Problem with path (?) when installing RStan on Win 7
parts:
Hello,

On Windows 7 my RTools is under an untypical directory, I have modified my path accordingly.
R 3.3.2  Rtools version 3.2.0.194

### edit ### Here was my mistake: RTools and R need to be same version, uninstalling and reinstalling to RTools 3.3 did the trick

cat('Sys.setenv(BINPREF = "C:\\untypical\\Rtools\\gcc-4.6.3\\bin\\")',
    file = file.path(Sys.getenv("HOME"), ".Rprofile"),
    sep = "\n", append = TRUE)

However the execution of the following:

fx <- inline::cxxfunction( signature(x = "integer", y = "numeric" ) , '
    return ScalarReal( INTEGER(x)[0] * REAL(y)[0] ) ;
' )

... generates the following error:

Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) : 
  Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! C:/untypical/Rtools/gcc-4.6.3/bing++: not found
make: *** [file19d028d2290b.o] Error 127
Warning message: etc...

I noticed the appended g++ right after the .../bin and suspect it may be the problem. Any idea how i could prevent this or hint on want is going wrong here?

I tried substituting \\ with / as well to no  avail.

Many thanks!

---JAP
